title: Passbook - free passbook facility for Individual Savings Account Customers
text: The Bank shall offer to all its Individual Savings Account Customers (referred to in subsequent paragraph as "customers") passbook facility free of cost.

title: Passbook - regular updation and intimation of errors or omissions
text: Customer to get their passbook updated from any branch on a regular basis. Customers are expected to examine the entries as reflected in the Passbook and immediately intimate the bank of any errors or omissions. The bank would then investigate the matter and rectify the discrepancy, if required.

title: Passbook - Bank's discretion to also provide mailed statements of account
text: Bank at its sole discretion may also, in addition to the passbook facility, decide to provide its customers with statement of accounts at monthly/quarterly or any other frequency and mail the same to the address registered with the bank.

title: Passbook - system generated entries requiring no authentication
text: Entries in the Passbook are system generated and thus, do not require any authentication /signature by a Bank official.

title: Passbook - charge for statement of account when updation is over 6 months overdue
text: In case the customer fails to get his/her passbook updated on a regular basis and, transactions to be updated in the passbook are older than 6 months, the bank would only provide a statement of account for the said period after collecting a nominal charge.

title: Passbook - for transaction verification only, not a balance confirmation certificate
text: The passbook only reflects the transactions details in the account and is to be used for verification of transactions. Balance as reflected in the passbook is not to be construed as a balance confirmation certificate issued by the bank.

title: Passbook - safe custody and duplicate passbook issuance on loss/damage
text: Customer to ensure safe custody of the passbook and in case the passbook issued is either lost, stolen, destroyed or spoilt, customer to make an application to the bank for issuance of a duplicate passbook. The bank would issue duplicate Passbook with only the current month transactions after levying a nominal charge as specified in the Schedule of Charges.
